collapse the now-agreeing rater1/rater2 codes into a single SkinCol variable
pull a four-digit birth year out of the birthday string by character position
narrow the working dataset down to a fixed list of columns to carry forward

collapse match-level rows into one row per referee, summing cards/games and computing a red-cards-per-match rate
collapse match-level rows into one row per referee country, summing cards/games and computing a red-cards-per-match rate

misalignments.decision: keep only rows where both raters logged a skin-tone rating and the two ratings match exactly
misalignments.claim: for cases where raters disagreed, the average of their skin tone ratings was used
misalignments.note: claim states rater disagreements were resolved by averaging the two ratings; code instead drops every row where the two ratings differ
